newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank probably selling mark-traders.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank probably selling mark-traders.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, probably sold marks on Friday as the crown weakened, Stockholm traders said.

One trader said central bank intervention had taken place. Other traders said they had not noted any direct central bank activity but said that the central bank often intervenes through just one commercial bank.
The crown had earlier weakened to 4.4650 versus the mark on what traders said were heavy commercial flows.
"There is no fundamental weakness and the Riksbank probably wanted to nudge the market and advise to to cool down," one chief dealer said.
"It's no surprise that bank is in," he added.
